# Apple Music (5 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Apple Music |
| /artist | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get an Apple Music artist |
| /album | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get an Apple Music album |
| /track | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get an Apple Music track |
| /charts | `country`?, `type`?, `limit`? | 1 | Get the Apple Music charts for a country |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 1cr

Returns Apple Music search results for a query. Pass `type` to restrict the result kind (for example song, album, or artist).

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search query.
- `type` *(optional)*: Optional result kind such as song, album, or artist.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /artist — 1cr

Returns artist metadata: id, name, artwork, and the Apple Music artist URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Apple Music artist ID. (one of: id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Apple Music artist URL. (one of: id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/artist?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /album — 1cr

Returns album metadata: title, artist, artwork, track count, and the Apple Music album URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Apple Music album ID. (one of: id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Apple Music album URL. (one of: id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/album?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /track — 1cr

Returns track metadata: title, artist, duration, preview audio URL, and the Apple Music track URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Apple Music track ID. (one of: id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Apple Music track URL. (one of: id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/track?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /charts — 1cr

Returns what a country is playing most on Apple Music right now: the Top Songs, Top Albums, Top Music Videos or Top Playlists chart, with no keyword in. Each item is a Post: `content.text` is the title, `author.username` the artist, `url` the Apple Music link and `content.thumbnail_url` the artwork. The chart position is on `ext.trend`: `rank` (1 is the top), `country_code`, `chart` and Apple's own `chart_title` and `updated_at`. `ext.apple_music` carries `kind`, `release_date`, `artist_id`, `artist_url`, `genres` and `content_advisory`. `published_at` is the release date at midnight UTC. Playlists have no artist or release date, so those are null. The item ids work with /v1/apple_music/track and /v1/apple_music/album for the full record. A country Apple Music does not publish a chart for is a free 400. Exact repeats within an hour are served from cache at 0 credits.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, in any case (`us`, `DE`, `kr`). Apple Music publishes a chart for most countries where it is sold; one it does not is rejected with a free 400. `uk` is read as `gb`. Defaults to `us`.
- `type` *(optional)*: Which chart: `songs` (the default), `albums`, `music-videos` or `playlists`.
- `limit` *(optional)*: How many chart positions to return, from the top, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/charts" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
